correctness.rationale: For every circumference at least three the complete local column cases imply that singleton count cannot rise. If it stays unchanged, no empty-column birth is possible, so full count decreases on any changed state. Therefore the integer (n+1)S+D is strictly decreasing at every non-fixed update, establishing finite-time fixation and excluding all temporal cycles of least period greater than one. The 16-state edge rule yields a bijection between labelled still lifes and length-n closed walks and the exact Newton-identity determinant. 87,360 direct transitions and the 3-by-4 witness were recomputed as independent finite corroboration.

value.rationale: The first height supporting a genuine Life oscillator on vertically open cyclic strips is a natural, sharply defined dynamical threshold. A proved strict all-configuration Lyapunov potential, finite-time upper bound, extension to finitely supported infinite strips, and exact all-circumference still-life spectrum supply structural information not obtained by scanning isolated finite rings. The theorem excludes every possible temporal period at width two and provides an explicit sharp height-three witness.
